ig_caption:
If you can't see what your agent did, you can't fix it 🔍

Langfuse: open-source tracing for LLM apps, running locally.
Every request to my two demo agents becomes a trace. One that failed:
❓ "Where is order Z-9999?"
1️⃣ the model calls get_order → tool ERROR: order not found
2️⃣ the model tells the customer it couldn't find it
⏱ latency and tokens on every step

Without this, all you know is a customer got a strange answer. At work, every agent on our platform is traced like this.

Part 1/4 of Agent Platform in Production. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
